title: four-layer layer-specific Mirror expert bank
hypothesis: A four-layer shared expert bank with one small Givens view per layer can preserve aligned layer-specific routed expert functions at materially lower serialized payload than four independent expert banks.
prior_experiment_delta: MA-241 tested two layers with soft evaluation of all experts. MA-014 scales to four layers and evaluates exactly one oracle-routed expert per example, measuring whether layer-specific views remain useful under sparse token choice.
physical_object: four 8x16x8 GELU expert banks shared across four layers
mirror_coordinate: per-layer 2D input/output Givens angles; role expert index is supplied separately
logical_multiplicity: 16 layer x expert functions from four physical expert functions
controls: one hard-tied four-expert bank across layers
tied bank plus per-layer/expert scalar gate
tied bank plus per-layer/expert rank-1 output residual
tied bank plus per-layer/expert rank-2 output residual
shared expert bank plus layer-specific Mirror views

task.routing: balanced oracle top-1; one expert evaluated for each example

teacher_modes.aligned: one shared four-expert bank conjugated by four layer-specific 2D Givens views

task.structure_audit: per-layer/expert MSE and exact one-expert route coverage

development.selection_metric: mean held-out MSE across six methods and both teacher modes

fresh.access_condition: At selected LR, aligned Mirror MSE <=1.25x independent and payload <=0.75x independent; otherwise fresh remains sealed.

storage.serialization: torch.save CPU state_dict plus deterministic compact JSON config

success_gate: All three fresh aligned worlds: Mirror MSE <=1.10x independent, payload <=0.65x independent, and >=10% lower MSE than hard tying at no more than 10% extra bytes. Compare to rank-1/rank-2 residuals before making a Mirror-specific claim.
failure_gate: Development gate misses; or >=2 fresh aligned worlds miss quality or bytes; or hard tie/low-rank control matches Mirror within 10% MSE at equal/lower bytes in >=2 worlds.
boundaries: aligned teacher deliberately favors Givens views
not a Transformer or language result
